transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the RollCall system. GRN-01 ensures energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption. GRN-02 promotes cloud solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers. GRN-03 allows for real-time updates using low-energy protocols. GRN-04 minimizes resource usage in report generation. GRN-05 raises awareness of carbon footprints, while GRN-06 aligns data retention with sustainability. Lastly, GRN-07 optimizes the interface for low-power devices, further enhancing energy efficiency. These requirements collectively foster a responsible approach to technology in education.

transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the necessity of high performance in the RollCall system to ensure a responsive and scalable experience for users. transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent highlights the critical need for security and privacy in the RollCall system. TRU-01 ensures all student data is encrypted at rest and in transit, protecting sensitive information. TRU-02 implements role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles, enhancing security. TRU-03 maintains an audit log of access and modifications, ensuring accountability. TRU-04 allows students to view their records only after authentication, safeguarding their privacy. TRU-05 verifies data integrity through checksums, while TRU-06 provides a mechanism for reporting unauthorized access. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts for inactive users, further securing the system. Together, these requirements provide a robust framework for data protection and trustworthiness in attendance tracking.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes with robust security checks.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis while ensuring compliance with regulations.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input, utilizing adaptive algorithms.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students, integrating energy-efficient algorithms.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second using adaptive algorithms.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms and resource management.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide an option to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall include a feature to notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
The system shall ensure data retention policies that align with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall offer a user interface that is optimized for low-power devices.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall verify the integrity of attendance data by implementing checksums or hashes.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
